notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35021043/c792458d4714eb1c0dcb13b70f0b8454bccc0509.png[/img]
Well guys, we took into consideration some of your feedback regarding what should be polished up next. Without further rambling here are the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Levels are now playable in any order. The player can still play in linear mode by using the End Level UI.
[*] Major performance optimizations.
[*] Improved the villagers AI. 
[*] Improved particle performance.
[*] Changed several sound effects.
[*] Corrected minor colliders in the menu.
[*] Corrected tutorial stones respawns.
[/list]
We will keep on working adding more content and polishing up game mechanics in the upcoming weeks.
We'll be more than happy to hear your feedback in the community forums.

[h1][b]Suggestions:[/b][/h1]
We hope you guys enjoy the game, and if you have any suggestions leave them in the suggestion section in the community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/2/

[h1][b]Bug reports[/b][/h1]
If you find any bugs feel free to report them in the community hub section.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1081250/discussions/0/

[h1][b]Discord[/b][/h1]
Come gather around a Giant Life! We'll be having weekly contest and giveaways!
[url=https://discord.gg/FF6dxzC]Join us on Discord![/url]
